transform_global_to_base: transform a point cloud from geocentric frame to robot base frame using current pose
transform_base_to_global: transform a point cloud from robot base frame to geocentric frame using current pose
is_obstacle_ahead: check if an obstacle is ahead of the robot by analyzing depth map and RGB images
goto_trackback: move the robot to a goal position in the base frame with optional distance optimization
goto: move the robot forward, left, or right toward a goal position with obstacle detection
